en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a large neoclassical academic building with three main floors, many evenly spaced windows, and a central arched entrance. The foreground includes a lawn and leafless trees, suggesting winter or early spring. Dense handwritten text in German covers the margins and lower part of the image. Printed in red below the picture is the title identifying the building as the Medical Institute at the University of Graz.
